policy: Authors freeze small complete batches and do not silently edit them during independent review.
Every essay requires a different editor to read all prose and ancillary fields against Chinese; structural checks do not prove quality.
Case citation positions and all source IDs/URLs stay exact; source notes are complete, not just link lists.
Keep original historical cutoffs and evidence status; new language release dates are not new historical verification dates.
No push. The author publishes the final local commit.
navigation: All five languages have native theory-to-case and case-to-theory companion links; one parent-series discovery update covers both routes, not duplicate Latest entries.
preservation: All eighteen original source JSONs, 54 original reading bodies and twenty complete primary main areas match the captured pre-expansion baselines. Primary changes are language controls and alternate links only.
